title: CRM contacts
html:
The place for adding and managing contact persons. The following can be recorded: surname, first name, name of the organisation, e-mail, phone number, status, address, tags and custom fields.

A contact person can be added with the New contact button or by importing from an Excel file (a sample file can be downloaded).

Contact persons can be assigned to a company (converted into a partner), or a new company can be created for them. One contact can be linked to several companies. The projects concerned are accessible from the contact's record.
